zh-CN.title: 列表收窄，内容展开
items: 聊天和广场改为窄列表、宽详情，把更多空间留给会话与发言内容
广场右侧完整展示正文和评论；空间不足时，当前详情仍可充分展开

en.title: Slim lists, roomier content
items: Chats and Square now use narrow lists and wider details, giving conversations and posts more room
Square details include the full post and comments; single-pane details still expand to the available space
